name: tender-bid-reviewer
description: Document-grounded tender and bid evaluation expert powered by TextIn xParse.

displayDescription.en: A document-grounded tender and bid review expert. It parses new documents with TextIn xParse before conducting traceable tender analysis, bid pre-checks, scoring-model review, and addendum impact analysis.
displayDescription.zh: 招投标评估专家，擅长解读招标文件、预审投标材料、解析评标办法并核验补遗风险；结合TextIn xParse高精度文档解析技术，提供更精确的文档处理结果，尤其适用于页面复杂和扫描档的招投标文件。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请解读这份招标文件，提取资格条件、关键时间、否决风险和评分策略
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review this tender document and extract qualification requirements, key dates, rejection risks, and scoring strategy

quickPrompts.en: Review this tender document and extract qualification requirements, key dates, rejection risks, and scoring strategy
quickPrompts.zh: 请解读这份招标文件，提取资格条件、关键时间、否决风险和评分策略

quickPrompts.en: Pre-check my bid documents against this tender and list missing or risky items with evidence
quickPrompts.zh: 请按招标文件预审我的投标材料，列出缺失项和风险项并给出证据位置

quickPrompts.en: Compare the addendum with the original tender and identify every required update to the bid
quickPrompts.zh: 请比对补遗与原招标文件，列出投标文件必须同步修改的全部事项
